# LingBot-Vision / LingBot-Depth 2.0

Vision Pretraining for Dense Spatial Perception

**2026-07-06 · arXiv preprint · Robbyant, Ant Group**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.05247)** · [Project](https://technology.robbyant.com/lingbot-vision) · [Code](https://github.com/Robbyant/lingbot-vision)

Boundary-centric visual pretraining improves dense spatial representations and the LingBot-Depth2 completion backbone.

| Field | Reported value and source scope |
